report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with mostly 62-78ms durations; one 344ms sample and a 425ms p95 are not sufficient to establish a fault. Traces show healthy downstream calls and pool idle=size=1. No evidence substantiates any taxonomy cause; operator hypothesis is contradicted by healthy telemetry, so hand off for baseline and sustained-signal data.
missing_evidence: Sustained latency/error telemetry for /v1/checkout beyond the single 344ms sample to establish a real degradation
Baseline p95 latency for /v1/checkout to judge whether 425ms p95 is anomalous
Downstream dependency latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) to localize any slowness
Error-rate or saturation metrics for downstream services to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
